column1: # Hooks that emulator/hookcheck.py would fail, and that are accepted. Columns (tab-separated): address of the
# jump or of the pointer word (or a range LO-HI, inclusive), date, reason. An entry needs evidence from the camera or a proof from the code. Keep this list short.

column3: stock-films-structure-3 (first remap7b-code), segment 1 to segment 2. The art colour-matrix step 0x7E56C603: every path past its first test (0x7E56C62D) reaches the hook. Accepted on camera evidence: flashed in every film build from remap7b-code (2026-11-12) to films-twelve-off (2026-11-21); docs/camera-log/ records no failed start or update. The colour stage runs at power-on for live view (docs/camera-log/2026-11-18-stock-films.md: code 88 before the loader ran). In the emulator runs of 2026-11-14 (normal start, quick start, update path) the function did not run before the copy, but the emulator has no live view (experiments/2026-11-14-emulator-audit/NOTES.md section 3): a test result on other paths, not a proof. Safe by timing only, not by a proof: the live-view start task USR_FAST (priority 6) runs while Usr1 (priority 11) copies segments 2 and 3, and nothing waits for the copies (experiments/2026-11-21-firmware-dive/NOTES.md section 2, static). Not known: the margin between the end of the segment-2 copy and the first run of this code. The build films-start-texts measures it (experiments/2026-11-21-firmware-dive/plan.md, criterion R1).

movie-ab (experiments/2026-11-19-movie-sampling/NOTES.md section 16), segment 1 to segment 2. The Movie IS crop 0x7E6CB860, HSHR case: the mov layer's frame builder reaches it only for a movie frame with Movie IS active (0x7E6C7656, movie params +32 and +36), so only in movie live view or recording, which the application (segments 2 and 3) starts. data/builds/debug-log-movie-ab.json passes boot-test and update-path-test. Not yet on the camera.

Not yet on the camera.

movie-ab (experiments/2026-11-19-movie-sampling/NOTES.md section 16), segment 1 to segment 2. The end of art_get_bayer_size 0x7E7290B5, whose 8 callers are art passes (0x7E71E899-0x7E72C85B) that run for a picture or a live-view frame with an art filter, after the application starts. data/builds/debug-log-movie-ab.json passes boot-test and update-path-test. Not yet on the camera.

card-looks-9, kernel data to segment 3. The entry word of task 0x90 (USRTEST_A) in the CPU0 task table. Proof from the code: the task is dormant in stock, and the one call that starts it is in T_GUI (gen/stock-films/loader.s), which the GUI state setter's hook 0x7ECDF6E4 in segment 2 reaches; so the entry runs only after segments 2 and 3 are in RAM, and never on the update path.

log-menu-3, kernel data to segment 2. The entry word of task 0x91 (USRTEST_B, the log's flush task) in the CPU0 task table. Proof from the code, as 7E439C80: dormant in stock, started only by T_GUI in segment 2 (gen/log-menu/mkspec.py).
